title: He Loved First
question: Where does our love come from, and what does it look like once it arrives?
blurb: Love that starts somewhere else. See where John says it goes next.

nodes.content: Where does our love come from, and what does it look like once it arrives?

nodes.verseText: We love because He first loved us.
And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
By this we know what love is: Jesus laid down His life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.
A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another.
and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.
